title: 班级玩具架
audio_introduction: Listen to the whole conversation. Write p or b in each blank.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Polly, our class has a little money for new toys. We have two shopping lists. My first toy is a ball. Its first letter is already written as the example.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: What else is on your list, Bill?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A panda and a boat. The panda will go beside the books. The boat can float in water.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I will choose a plane and a bear. The plane has blue wings. The bear is soft and brown.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: My last two toys are a penguin and a bus. The penguin is black and white. The bus has four wheels.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: My list also has a puzzle, a pig and a bike. The pig is pink. The bike has two wheels.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Let us show both lists to our teacher before we buy the toys.

instruction: 听一段完整对话，完成两个人各五行的清单。左列首行为已解示例，其余9处只填 p 或 b，不填完整单词。源遍数及读答时间未知；本机单遍、前后各20秒，可重播，属于审阅安排。
local_rate_notice: 本机对话按实测词速做保留音高的减速，约110英文词/分钟；不是原录音速度，也未完成儿童难度或自然听辨标定。
scope_notice: 香港KS1学段官方教学形式的原创参照；未绑定内地小学具体年级，不计入15档年级覆盖或当前内地非纸笔真题。两列、9响应、一个示例、p/b候选和整段对话保留；主题和措辞为原创。
